title: US Officials Warn of Increase in Bacterial Illnesses That Could Be Deadly (2/2)
titleZh: 美國官方警告：可能致命的細菌感染增加（2/2）
summaryZh: 說明這種細菌感染的死亡率與後遺症，以及疫苗接種建議。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — Health & Lifestyle

sentences.text: An estimated 10 to 15 percent of infected people die.
sentences.zh: 估計每一百名感染者中，有十到十五人會死亡。

sentences.text: And survivors sometimes lose the ability to hear, or body parts must be surgically removed.
sentences.zh: 存活下來的人有時候會失去聽力，或是必須以手術切除部分肢體。

sentences.text: There also are vaccines against meningococcal disease.
sentences.zh: 目前也有預防腦膜炎雙球菌疾病的疫苗。

sentences.text: Officials suggest that all children should get a meningococcal conjugate vaccine around the age of 11. Since vaccine protection weakens over time,
sentences.zh: 官員建議所有兒童在十一歲左右接種一劑腦膜炎雙球菌結合型疫苗。由於疫苗的保護力會隨時間減弱，

sentences.text: the CDC also suggests a second shot at age 16. The CDC also suggests the shots for people at higher risk.
sentences.zh: CDC 也建議在十六歲時再打第二劑。CDC 同時建議高風險族群接種這種疫苗。

sentences.text: Higher risk individuals might include those who live where an outbreak is taking place, or those with HIV infection, or other kinds of health conditions.
sentences.zh: 高風險族群可能包括住在疫情爆發地區的人、感染愛滋病毒的人，或是有其他健康狀況的人。
